A full card image re-made by the Players Committee with the mark D-E1 in the lower border (12 November 2022). Its words are the Players Committee's errata for this card; Decipher published no errata text for it.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Hoth-L-bactatank-PC-Errata-D-E1-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with the printed card [[Bacta Tank]] (Decipher, November 1996): The whole card is drawn again at 745 × 1039 pixels: sharper art and frame, lore and game text set again, and the mark “D-E1” in the black lower border. The game text now reads: “Use 4 Force to deploy on your side of table. A non-droid character you just lost may be placed here. Holds 1 ‘patient’ at a time. During your deploy phase, may use X Force to bring ‘patient’ to hand, where X = deploy cost of ‘patient.’”

The whole earlier card image and the whole of this card image, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited.
